trust_decision.summary: The local fork service (hagent server, separate process) is trusted only when the request carries the webui-supplied per-process id header (_x-whistle-uid_ === config.uid); the check is the first middleware of the service app, and the header is deleted before routing.

landing_point.why: A reader told only 'path traversal' with CWE-22 looks at the only request-controlled filesystem read: /cgi-bin/temp/get, which joins a hash-shaped filename with TEMP_FILES_PATH but passes any other filename straight to getFile() -> fs.readFile.

fix_sites.entry_point: every route of the internal service HTTP API on the forked child (/cgi-bin/temp/*, /cgi-bin/saved/*, /cgi-bin/sessions/*, /service/*); normally reached only through the webui proxy app.all('/cgi-bin/temp/*', sendToService) at biz/webui/lib/index.js:539
fix_sites.module_kind: express middleware in the forked service process

fix_sites.entry_point: webui proxy producer: biz/webui/lib/index.js:84 sets req.headers[common.WHISTLE_UID_HEADER] = config.uid on each sendToService call; the constant is added by the fix (fix.diff:880)
fix_sites.module_kind: shared util / protocol constant (lib layer, consumed by the biz/ UI package)

fix_sites.entry_point: /cgi-bin/temp/get filename parsing (lib/service/service.js:458-461) and the webui-side gate isTempFile() at biz/webui/lib/index.js:66-79, which calls the missing common.getTempFile at the pinned commit

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The service is a loopback-only child process that only the webui is supposed to talk to, so it does not need its own check - a solver fixes the filename handling in /cgi-bin/temp/get and leaves the unauthenticated service port open.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Reading a caller-supplied local path through the same sink is a supported UI feature, not only a bug: /cgi-bin/import-remote rewrites any non-http(s) url into /cgi-bin/temp/get?filename=<that path> (biz/webui/lib/index.js:432-435), and the rules editor treats any tempFile containing a slash as an existing file to load through getTempFile (biz/webui/htdocs/src/js/editor-dialog.js:178-179, data-center.js:681). A filename whitelist in temp/get breaks both.

O6_input_shapes: arbitrary absolute or ../-relative path (what the sink passes to fs.readFile when the shape does not match)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /cgi-bin/temp/get?filename=<any local path> when config.username and config.password are set: the webui filename gate is guarded by !hasLogin(), so with login configured a logged-in or guest caller still reaches getFile() with an arbitrary path
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: with a login enabled the caller is authenticated, and reading an arbitrary local file is an advertised feature (import-remote), so this path is not the vulnerability
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the webui guard, different layer from the service-side fix

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second 'temp path' parser (TEMP_PATH_RE, allows 'blank' and a 1-20 char suffix) used by getTempFilePath and plugin load-plugin, diverging from TEMP_FILE_RE
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: rule file://temp/<hash> resolution and the UI already need a looser shape than the hash-only temp/get regex, so a maintainer could plausibly add a third shape here and have the two parsers disagree on the protected item's identity

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another route in the same app that builds a path from request input (/cgi-bin/saved/sessions), protected only by a character blacklist in getFilename at lib/service/service.js:93-97
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: saved sessions are the sibling of temp files in the same service app, and a maintainer adding a read route here would copy the existing pattern

O8b_injection_room.sibling: plugin page assets served via fs.createReadStream(path.join(plugin.path, filepath)) where filepath comes from req.path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: plugin static serving is the natural place to add another file route in the webui, and path.join normalises .. so the join alone does not contain the read

O9_family: path traversal / arbitrary local file read (CWE-22) behind a missing request-authenticity check

O10_build.toolchain: npm; no build step required for the server code (eslint + tape for tests, webpack only for the htdocs UI bundle)
O10_build.project_tests: tape suite: test/index.test.js plus test/units/*.test.js exercising the proxy and rules; no test covers the webui service temp/get or the internal service port (grep for temp/get, isTempFile, import-remote in test/ returns nothing), and the fix diff adds no tests.

j.j_sites_touched: lib/util/common.js, lib/service/service.js (producer biz/webui/lib/index.js is unchanged by the diff but must agree on the constant)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Validate or normalise the filename inside /cgi-bin/temp/get in lib/service/service.js (refuse anything that does not normalise under TEMP_FILES_PATH), which closes the reported read but breaks the UI local-file import via /cgi-bin/import-remote and the temp/<hash>.<ext> forms, and still leaves the service port callable without any webui involvement.
